Hi Sam — thanks for the heads up and timeline. Short answers up front, then specifics below:

- We have a downloadable Type II report (PDF) for audit period 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31.
- We can provide a signed bridge letter that confirms no material changes since the report cutoff; standard wording attached.
- Delivery: we prefer a secure download link (Expiring S3 presigned link) or a shared GDrive link with viewer-only access; if you require DocuSign for the bridge letter we can route that too.

What we'll share immediately: the Type II PDF, the bridge-letter template, and a short evidence index describing what artifacts we can reasonably provide on short notice (access logs, change control records, configuration snapshots). If you expect auditors to request raw logs, let us know the date range and we will coordinate temporary secure transfer.

Next steps I propose:
1) I will upload the report and bridge-letter template to a secure link and send the link to this thread by EOD today.
2) If you want the bridge letter signed now, please confirm whether a PDF with an electronic signature is acceptable or if DocuSign is required.
3) For any additional artifact requests, please provide the exact scope so we can pull the correct exports (we typically need 3–5 business days for targeted log exports).

Attaching our standard bridge-letter template and an evidence index CSV for your procurement team.

Regards,

Hi all — confirming the following and next steps: 

- Distribution: the 2026 Type II PDF is approved for external distribution to vetted prospects and requires no redaction for standard procurement review. File: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (we will publish as an expiring download).

- Bridge letter: we can provide a signed bridge letter. Electronic signature on the PDF is acceptable in most cases; if your legal team requires DocuSign, we'll request the envelope from you. Typical turnaround for the signed bridge letter is 1 business day once we have the customer name and effective date.

- Evidence and logs: for targeted log exports (e.g., authentication and admin activity) we typically need 3 business days to prepare exports and scrub PII; full raw log dumps for longer windows may take more time and require an NDA addendum. For standard procurement diligence, we can provide:
  * Access logs (filtered): 30-day window — 3 business days
  * Change control records (tickets + approval notes): 2 business days
  * Configuration snapshots: 1 business day

- Delivery options: we will send an expiring S3 link for the PDF and bridge-letter template. For large evidence exports we use an encrypted SFTP transfer or a pre-authorized cloud bucket with temporary creds.

Action items: 
- Sam / procurement: confirm if a PDF with e-sign is sufficient for the bridge letter or if you want DocuSign.
- Rishi: I'll stage the Type II PDF and bridge template and send the secure link within the hour.
- Vivek: please confirm estimated timeline for a 30-day auth/admin log export (I expect ~3 business days).

Thanks,
